description: List securities currently halted across NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX (from the consolidated Nasdaq Trader halt feed). Each halt includes ticker, market, haltCode (T1/T2/T12/LUDP/H10/...), human-readable reason, haltedAt, haltAgeDays, and the scheduled resumptionAt when one is set. `halts` holds halts that began within the last 30 days; `longRunningHalts` holds older halts the feed still lists (often regulatory halts that have lasted months or years); they are not new halts. `asOf` is when the list was read. An empty list is a normal state (no active halts right now), not an error. Halt rows carry no price.
name: get_trading_halts
title: Get Active Trading Halts
